title: Music Video Ideas, Each Made Into a Real AI Short
summary: 14 music video ideas to borrow, from a fight on an opera stage to a dance in the kitchen, each shown as a real AI shot made in Flick, with its prompt.
body_markdown:
### What are some good music video ideas?


Good music video ideas include a performance in an unexpected place, such as a boxing match on an opera stage, a small story like a family road trip, a visual rule like a split screen, or an animated folk tale. Each one is a single image or situation that a whole song can hold.


### How do I come up with a music video idea?


Listen to the song and write down the first picture it gives you, then reduce it to one place, one or two characters and one camera choice. If the idea needs a paragraph to explain, cut it down until it fits in a sentence.


### What are low budget music video ideas?


Low budget ideas use one location and one person, such as a slow performance in a single room, a hummed line in a landscape or a locked shot of a party. With AI you can generate those shots without a crew, a set or a location fee.


### What are music video ideas for a love song?


A love song suits a couple dancing in their kitchen, a memory of one summer on a beach, or two people looking up at the sky together. Keep the camera close and handheld so the shots stay about the feeling rather than the place.


### Can I make a music video with AI?


Yes. You write a prompt for each shot, an AI video model generates the clips, and you cut them to your song on a timeline. In Flick the song, the reference images and every take sit on one canvas, and you can upload your own track or make one with Text to Music.


### Can I make an AI music video for free?


You can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up and 100 credits every week, which cover Text to Music and MiniMax H3 Max video. Seedance 2.0 needs the Standard plan ($20 a month).


### Can I use these music video ideas for my own video?


Yes, an idea is free to borrow as a starting point, but the films, their characters and their images belong to the filmmakers who made them, so make the idea your own with your song and your characters.
